chars.NARRATOR: NARRATOR: a young Moroccan man about 25, short black hair, trimmed short beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and grey joggers
chars.SISTERINLAW: SISTERINLAW: a Moroccan woman about 30, long dark wavy hair in a loose low bun, wearing a modest long-sleeved maroon velvet pyjama set covering arms and legs

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Night inside a Moroccan house in Tangier: SISTERINLAW tiptoes down a dim hallway lit by a small lamp, glancing back over her shoulder with a sly curious look, toward a closed bedroom door. 2D cartoon style, warm night colours, subject centred

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR lying awake on a simple guest bed in a small Moroccan bedroom at night, phone glowing in his hand, eyes wide, turning his head toward the door as he hears noises outside. Subject centred

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR opens the bedroom door a crack and finds SISTERINLAW standing right outside in the dark hallway, both surprised; he looks shocked, she smiles innocently. Subjects centred

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: In the hallway at night SISTERINLAW talks sweetly to NARRATOR, hand on her chest, asking if he needs anything, while he stands awkwardly scratching his head. Subjects centred

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR sits on his guest bed, startled, as SISTERINLAW steps back into his bedroom doorway at night with a playful look. Moroccan bedroom with patterned blanket. Subjects centred

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: SISTERINLAW leaning on the door frame of NARRATOR's room, smiling, saying she will stay with him a little; NARRATOR on the bed with a nervous forced smile, sweating. Subjects centred

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of NARRATOR sitting on the bed, eyes wide in panic, biting his lip, thinking 'she is my brother's wife', a family wedding photo frame on the wall behind him (no text). Subject centred

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: NARRATOR points awkwardly toward the stairs telling SISTERINLAW her room is upstairs, while she laughs and waves her hand dismissively, standing inside his room at night. Subjects centred

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: SISTERINLAW sits down right next to NARRATOR on the edge of his bed at night, smiling; NARRATOR freezes stiff, leaning away with a comically shocked face. Subjects centred
